name: Qelochia
source:
On a secret arctic research base, a scientist, soldier, AI, and eldritch beast struggle for happiness. A short visual novel about love and pain set in an alternate history where humanity is ruled by eldritch gods.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4292790/Qelochia/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一个秘密的北极研究基地，科学家、士兵、人工智能和可怕的野兽为幸福而奋斗。一部关于爱与痛苦的短篇视觉小说，背景设定在另一个历史中，人类被邪恶的神统治。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4292790/Qelochia/]Steam[/url]]
